name: scene-preserve-onfigureplain-studio
notes: Reproduces + tests the fix for the 2026-09-08 live finding: a real Pelagic 'Leaderman' Ad (mediaId 6a9d36e8c329c79c84e5a68e) generated a person correctly wearing the shorts but stuck on a blank studio backdrop. Root cause: resolveSeedStyle maps BOTH the LLM shotType 'lifestyle' and 'on_model' to the coarse seedStyle 'lifestyle', with no check on whether the seed's actual background is a real environment or a studio backdrop. This exact seed is classified shotType:on_model (0.98 conf), background reason 'A cropped male model is wearing the shorts against a plain studio backdrop.' SCENE_PRESERVE then fired ('the photograph is the finished plate, do not rebuild the background'), which is correct for a real lifestyle scene but wrong here. Fix: shouldPreserveScene now accepts an optional seedClass (imageShotHeuristicService.resolveSeedClass) and vetoes preserve when seedClass === 'on_figure_plain', gated on SEED_CLASS_SCENE_BASED. 'before' variants omit seedClass (reproduces today's shipped bug-for-bug). 'after' variants set seedClass:'on_figure_plain' (the fix). Run with SEED_CLASS_SCENE_BASED=true in the environment — STATIC_LIFESTYLE_PRESERVE is already true via config/defaults.env.
